## What's new in Dropshake v1.2.1

- The shelf fades in when it opens and fades out when it hides.
- The top-corner diagonal resize target is slightly smaller, leaving the close button easier to click.
- The installer instructions now remind you to eject the DMG after copying Dropshake into Applications.

## Install

Download `Dropshake.dmg`, open it, drag Dropshake into Applications, then eject the Dropshake disk in Finder. Requires macOS 13 or later. The universal app supports both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
